name: How much does it cost to hire a neonatal injury lawyer?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a neonatal injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most neonatal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically do not pay any upfront fees or hourly charges. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the compensation they secure for you, either through a settlement or a court award. If they don't win your case, you generally don't owe them attorney fees. This arrangement allows families to pursue justice without the burden of immediate legal costs, making legal representation accessible.
